hcn.temperature_fit_anchor: Use the reviewed fit only for its temperature trend, anchored to the separately preferred 298.15 K pKa; the fit alone gives pKa 9.29 at 298.15 K.

ammonium.extended_temperature_note: The constant-heat-capacity extrapolation from the 298.15 K selected values is approximate above 323.15 K; direct enthalpy measurements were reported from 278 to 418 K.

carbonate.neutral_pool: dissolved CO2 plus hydrated H2CO3, represented together as CO2(aq)
carbonate.temperature_note: The selected pKa, enthalpy and heat-capacity values are at 298.15 K and infinite dilution. Constant-heat-capacity temperature extrapolation to the boiler is approximate; CO2 hydration is assumed equilibrated.

water.ionization_model: IAPWS R11-24 equations 2-4 with liquid-water density

limitations: Ideal dilute activities and no external buffer, strong ions, other aqueous acid-base pairs or aqueous kinetic reactions are assumed.
CO2(aq) and H2CO3 are lumped into the neutral CO2 pool; their hydration is assumed equilibrated at the substep boundary.
This dataset supplies equilibrium constants only, not a calibrated pH, gas-water mass-transfer rate or kinetic yield model.
Above 323.15 K, the ammonium and carbonate pKa temperature adjustments use constant-heat-capacity extrapolation and are not directly validated at the boiler temperature.
